description: This file implements health check functionality for language models used in a proxy setup. It includes utility functions for generating messages, cleaning endpoint data, filtering models, and performing asynchronous health checks with timeout handling. The code updates parameters for health checks based on model info and system configuration, and provides an entry point for running a comprehensive health check on a list of models.

methods.name: _get_random_llm_message()
methods.description: Generates a random message from a predefined list for health check input.

methods.name: _clean_endpoint_data(endpoint_data: dict, details: Optional[bool] = True)
methods.description: Removes sensitive or irrelevant data from endpoint data for display purposes.

methods.name: List filter_deployments_by_id( model_list: List, )
methods.description: Filters a list of deployment configs, removing duplicates based on model ID.

methods.name: run_with_timeout(task, timeout)
methods.description: Executes an async task with a specified timeout, canceling other tasks if timeout occurs.

methods.name: _perform_health_check(model_list: list, details: Optional[bool] = True)
methods.description: Performs health checks on a list of models asynchronously, returning healthy and unhealthy endpoints.

methods.name: dict _update_litellm_params_for_health_check( model_info: dict, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Modifies the model parameters for the health check, adjusting model names, messages, and other config based on model info.

methods.name: perform_health_check( model_list: list, model: Optional[str] = None, cli_model: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[bool] = True, )
methods.description: Main function to perform overall health checks on models, with optional filtering by specific model name and detailed output.
